save-coffee: Cover: “Save 10,000 a day — coffee!!”, a vintage collage of cash, bank cards and a cup of coffee
Coffee lovers spend on average 10,000₮ a day, 300,000₮ a month and 3,650,000₮ a year at coffee shops
How can this expense be cut to 1,670₮ a day?
The quickest, easiest way: make your own coffee, with a pour-over coffee maker illustration
What you need: 500 g of ground beans for 45,000₮, 100 paper filters for 5,000₮ and a drip coffee set for 60,000₮
The maths: one cup costs 1,620₮, saving 8,330₮ a day, 249,900₮ a month and 2,980,450₮ a year
Financial discipline isn't giving up what you love; it starts with small habits

meta.title: Pricing — Daria
meta.description: Website packages from 650,000₮ and Boost-ready poster packages from 70,000₮.

pricing.title: Website packages
pricing.intro: One-time payment. Pick the package that fits your business.

promo.label: Launch promo
promo.text: For my first 2 clients: Business Pro for 990,000₮, in exchange for an honest review on my Facebook page and permission to feature your site in my portfolio.

starter.name: Starter
starter.for: Service businesses, clinics and consultants who need a clean online presence without frequent edits.
features: Looks great on phones and computers
Direct call, Messenger and location buttons
starter.care: One-time delivery, no monthly fee. Small edits are billed per request.

business.name: Business Pro
business.for: Product sellers, courses and restaurants that want to take orders and update items themselves.
features: Admin panel to add and edit products, prices and text
Order or booking form that sends orders to email, Telegram or a dashboard
business.care: 1 month of free bug fixes after launch.

premium.name: Premium
premium.for: Growing companies that want full automation, QPay payments and hands-free care.
features: Online payments (QPay / SocialPay) or advanced CRM integration
Custom animations and a multi-section sales funnel
premium.care: 3 months of free full care and updates, then 100,000₮/month (optional).

pricing.note: Domain (about 40,000₮ a year) and hosting/server costs are paid separately by you, in your own name, so the website and domain are fully yours.

posters.title: Boost-ready posters
posters.intro: I don't just draw pretty pictures. I design sales posters that grab attention in 3 seconds and make your Facebook Boost budget go further.

why.label: Why it matters
why.text: Boosted posters packed with small text get less reach on Facebook, so your ad budget reaches fewer people. A clear, focused poster gets you more for the same spend.

starter.name: Starter Pack
features: A mix of product/service and trust-building posts

growth.name: Growth Pack
features: Bonus: free Facebook cover banner refresh

posters.note: You provide the product photos and the raw information. Each poster includes up to 2 small text or color tweaks.
